items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I left Minneapolis and saw him with Buddy Rogers.

ctx.x: I left Minneapolis and saw him with Buddy Rogers. I said, "Where's Gene?" "You talking about Gene Krupa? He's upstairs." Gene used to get the room upstairs and I would be playing the drums downstairs and it was just because of the situation.

I happened to mention that and the last few drummers I mentioned, most of them were white. I was trying to just make an analogy here, Jo. It seems as if every one of the great white bands was really steamrolled by these very great drummers we've just named. We haven't talked about one which I want to talk about first, ask you about - Davy Tough.
